readout_other: concurrent BOLD fMRI and multispectral optoacoustic tomography (HbO, HbR, HbT)
direction_notes: hTUS evoked negative BOLD signals in the RSC together with increased HbT, HbO and HbR (HbR rising more than HbO); the BOLD response appeared only above about 0.4 MPa.
safety_notes: High-resolution anatomical MRI of three mice showed no visible tissue damage or abnormalities in the RSC 10 days after the hTUS experiments; body temperature was monitored.

exposures.label: Holographic (multifocal) TUS of right RSC, concurrent fMRI and OAT

target.label: right RSC of the mouse brain

timing.protocol_description: A 100-ms ultrasound pulse at 3 MHz delivered at 4 Hz for 8 s (22 s interstimulation interval, 6 epochs) or 20 s (60 s interval, 5 epochs); pressure levels of 0, 0.3, 0.4 and 0.52 MPa were applied; three foci were sonicated simultaneously (holographic).

source_quotes.n_subjects: Eight C57BL/6J mice (Charles River Laboratories, Germany, 6 to 10 weeks) and six athymic female nude mice (Foxn1<sup>nu</sup>, Charles River Laboratories, Germany, 6 to 10 weeks) were used in this study.

source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: To further validate the negative BOLD signals that were evoked by TUS, we applied varying pressure levels of 0, 0.3, 0.4, and 0.52 MPa (table S1 and Materials and Methods).

flags.reason: 0.52 MPa is the focal pressure measured through an excised mouse skull; other levels (0.3, 0.4, text; 0.41 in Fig. 3 legend) are named in the protocol description only and the domain of those is not stated.
14 = 8 C57BL/6J + 6 nude mice 'used in this study'; not all were necessarily sonicated (group analyses use n = 6); postmortem controls were also run.
No sham arm; control sonications were delivered with the same parameters after euthanasia, plus 0 MPa rest-state scans.
Auditory/visual cortex BOLD was inspected within the same fMRI data; no separate auditory control.
Array maker is not named; DAQ credited to Falkenstein Mikrosysteme and described as customized.
Paper calls the 100 ms an 'emission duration'/'pulse duration'; with 4 Hz PRF and 40% duty cycle it is consistent as the pulse. Not resolved by arithmetic.
